verdict.rationale: Superhuman's Split Inbox lets users divide the inbox into areas of focus, with user-designed categories such as "VIP", "Calendar" and "Team". Custom AI Auto Labels can become inbox tabs, and built-in labels like News separate newsletter-type mail. A community user corroborates that promotional mail goes into a separate 'other' folder. Missing for 10: custom AI Auto Labels are limited to Business/Enterprise plans, no explicit documentation on ordering streams by priority, and independent corroboration is thin.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can split my inbox into focused streams — important, team, newsletters, calendar invites — so triage happens in priority order, not arrival order

citations.quote: But in Superhuman Mail, you can design your own categories: like "VIP", "Notifications", "Calendar", or "Team".
splitting your inbox allows you to divide your inbox into different areas of focus
you can make your own Auto Labels with short AI prompts, and then split your inbox into tabs using these custom Auto Labels.
